description_en: Queries information about backup files for a Redis-compatible ApsaraDB for Tair instance
description_zh: 查询云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的备份文件信息
name: DescribeBackups

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup file
parameters.name: backup_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup job returned by the `CreateBackup` operation. If `CreateBackup` returns multiple backup job IDs, call this operation for each ID
parameters.help_zh: 备份任务ID，由CreateBackup返回，CreateBackup若返回多个BackupJobId，则需要使用本接口分别对其查询
parameters.name: backup_job_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return per page. Valid values: `30`, `50`, `100`, `200`, and `300`
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number to return. The value must be greater than 0. The default value is 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The start time for the query. Specify the time in UTC using the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time for the query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in UTC using the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，必须晚于查询开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable AOF persistence. Valid values:

0: Disabled.

1: Enabled.

The default value is 0
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启AoF落盘，取值：
0：关闭。
1：开启。

默认值：0
parameters.name: need_aof

AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 本组参数已弃用，请忽略

items.description_en: The details of a backup set

BackupDBNames.description_en: The backed-up databases. A value of all indicates that all databases were backed up
BackupDBNames.description_zh: 备份的数据库，默认为all，即备份所有数据库

BackupDownloadURL.description_en: The public download URL of the backup set
BackupDownloadURL.description_zh: 备份文件的外网下载地址

BackupEndTime.description_en: The completion time of the backup

BackupId.description_en: The ID of the backup set

BackupIntranetDownloadURL.description_en:
The internal download URL of the backup set.

You can use this URL to download the backup set from an ECS instance that is in the same VPC as the database instance
BackupIntranetDownloadURL.description_zh:
备份文件的内网下载地址。

您可以在与该实例连通的ECS（二者需属于同一VPC内）上使用该地址下载目标备份文件

BackupJobID.description_en: The ID of the backup job

BackupMethod.description_en:
The backup method. Valid values:

Logical: A logical backup.

Physical: A physical backup
BackupMethod.description_zh:
备份方法，返回值：
Logical：逻辑备份。
Physical：物理备份。

BackupMode.description_en:
The backup mode. Valid values:

Automated: An automated backup.

Manual: A manual backup
BackupMode.description_zh:
备份模式，返回值：
Automated：自动备份。
Manual：手动备份。

BackupSize.description_en: The size of the backup set, in bytes

BackupStartTime.description_en: The start time of the backup

BackupStatus.description_en:
The backup status. Valid values:

Success: The backup was successful.

Failed: The backup failed
BackupStatus.description_zh:
备份状态，返回值：
Success：成功。
Failed：失败

BackupType.description_en:
The backup type. Valid values:

FullBackup: A full backup.

IncrementalBackup: An incremental backup
BackupType.description_zh:
备份类型，返回值：
FullBackup：全量备份。
IncrementalBackup：增量备份

EngineVersion.description_en: The engine version of the instance. It specifies the compatible Redis version
EngineVersion.description_zh: 引擎版本，即实例兼容Redis的版本

ExpectExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the backup set. The time is in UTC and uses the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format
ExpectExpireTime.description_zh: 备份集过期时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC 时间）

NodeInstanceId.description_en:
The node ID.

For a Standard Edition instance, this parameter returns the instance ID
NodeInstanceId.description_zh:
节点ID。
当实例的架构为标准版时，本参数返回的是实例ID

RecoverConfigMode.description_en:
Indicates whether the backup set includes configuration information such as accounts (`account`), kernel parameters (`config`), and allowlists (`whitelist`).

This parameter is available only for Cloud Native Edition instances. If you modify these settings, for example, create an account or add an IP address to an allowlist, the updated information is automatically included in subsequent backup sets
RecoverConfigMode.description_zh:
备份集中是否包含了账号（account）、内核参数（whitelist）、白名单（config）信息。
本参数仅适用于云原生版实例。若您修改实例的上述信息（例如新建了一个账号或添加了一个白名单），在后续的备份集中会自动备份上述信息

FreeSize.description_en:
<props="china">The free backup quota for the instance, in bytes. The free quota is equal to the default memory size of the instance type. For more information, see [Changes to the free backup quota policy]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2664017.html）.
Full backups and log backups share this free quota. When the instance type is changed, the free quota also changes.</props>
<props="intl">This parameter is not in effect. Ignore this parameter.</props>
FreeSize.description_zh:
<props="china">该实例的免费备份额度，单位是字节，免费额度为实例规格默认内存量，更多信息请参见[备份商业化通知]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2664017.html）。
全量备份和日志备份共享该免费额度。当变配实例规格时，实例的免费额度会产生变化。</props>
<props="intl">该参数未生效，请忽略该参数。</props>

FullStorageSize.description_en:
The total size of full backups for the instance, in bytes. Full backups are generated from scheduled daily backups, manual backups, or cache analysis.

This value represents the total size of all valid full backups for the instance, regardless of the backup sets returned in this request
FullStorageSize.description_zh:
当前实例全量备份文件的大小，单位是字节。全量备份来源于每天定时备份、手动备份、缓存分析时生成的备份等。
该值和当前请求所响应的备份集数量以及大小无关，而是该实例当前所有有效全量备份的大小

LogStorageSize.description_en:
The total size of log backups for the instance, in bytes. This parameter is returned only if flashback is enabled.

This value represents the total size of all valid log backups for the instance, regardless of the backup sets returned in this request
LogStorageSize.description_zh:
当前实例日志备份文件的大小，单位是字节，当且仅当开启闪回时才有效。
该值和当前请求所响应的备份集数量以及大小无关，而是该实例当前所有有效日志备份的大小

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of backup sets
